method: Every published vehicle video was downloaded, sampled at 4-5 points across its duration, converted to still frames and visually reviewed frame by frame. Listing photos were also reviewed. Only facts visible on screen are recorded; anything not visible is written as 'Not verified'.
limitations: Video review is not a mechanical inspection. No engine, chassis, service-history or OBD check was performed.
Several videos carry third-party dealer branding, meaning that footage was sourced rather than filmed at DM Motor Group. Those vehicles are marked 'sourced footage - physical presence unconfirmed'.
Mileage, VIN, engine number, registration year and accident history are not visible in the footage and are never inferred.
Colours are as they appear on screen under the lighting in the footage; paint codes are not verified.
